content.value_statement: Manual spreadsheet review slows reporting and hides data quality issues. This skill guides Excel analysis with pandas, pivot tables, charts, cleaning steps, and formatted exports.
actual_capabilities: Reads Excel workbooks and previews spreadsheet rows with pandas.
Processes multiple sheets from one workbook.
Groups, filters, sorts, and calculates spreadsheet metrics.
Creates pivot tables from Excel data.
Generates chart images from spreadsheet columns.
Writes cleaned or formatted Excel output files.
limitations: Requires Python packages such as pandas, openpyxl, xlrd, xlsxwriter, and matplotlib.
Examples require users to adapt file names, sheet names, and column names.
Does not include built-in protection for sensitive spreadsheet data.
Very large workbooks may need separate memory and performance planning.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sales Reports
use_cases.description: Summarize sales workbooks by region, product, or customer before sharing regular reports.

use_cases.title: Clean Finance Spreadsheets
use_cases.description: Remove duplicates, fill missing values, convert dates, and export cleaner finance workbooks.

use_cases.title: Build Workbook Visuals
use_cases.description: Create charts and pivot summaries from tabular Excel data for presentations or reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel Analysis skill to read my workbook, show the first rows, and summarize the available columns.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Spreadsheet Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel Analysis skill to remove duplicates, handle missing values, convert date fields, and save a cleaned workbook.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pivot Summary
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel Analysis skill to build a pivot table that summarizes sales by region and product.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an Analysis Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Excel Analysis skill to combine sheets, calculate metrics, create charts, format the output workbook, and explain the results.

output_examples.input: A sales workbook with region, product, sales, revenue, and cost columns.
output_examples.output: A summary of total sales by region, a profit margin column, and a ranked list of high sales rows.

output_examples.input: A messy customer workbook with duplicate names, missing values, and inconsistent date columns.
output_examples.output: A cleaned workbook with duplicates removed, missing values handled, whitespace trimmed, and dates converted.

output_examples.input: A product performance workbook that needs a visual summary.
output_examples.output: A pivot table by product and region, plus chart files that show category totals and market share.

best_practices: Confirm worksheet names and important columns before running analysis.
Keep an unchanged copy of the original workbook.
Review generated charts and formulas before sharing results.
anti_patterns: Do not run examples on sensitive workbooks without checking data handling requirements.
Do not assume column names match the examples.
Do not overwrite source files when creating cleaned or formatted outputs.

faq.question: What file types does this skill address?
faq.answer: It focuses on Excel workbooks, including modern .xlsx files and older .xls files when supported packages are available.

faq.question: Can it create pivot tables?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows how to create pivot tables with pandas and export the result to Excel.

faq.question: Can it generate charts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes matplotlib examples for bar charts and pie charts based on spreadsheet columns.

faq.question: Does it modify my original workbook?
faq.answer: The examples usually write separate output files, but users should check paths before running adapted code.

faq.question: Which Python libraries are mentioned?
faq.answer: The skill mentions pandas, openpyxl, xlrd, xlsxwriter, and matplotlib.

faq.question: Does it handle every large workbook automatically?
faq.answer: No. Large files may require column selection, data type planning, or a separate performance strategy.
